summary: NexPoint Real Estate Finance entered into a $375M senior secured term loan with Mizuho Capital Markets, drawing $310M on April 29, 2026, to refinance $185.2M of its 5.75% senior unsecured notes due May 1, 2026. The facility matures May 1, 2029, with two six-month extension options, and bears interest at SOFR+4.0% (2.0% floor). Concurrently, a Total Return Swap with Mizuho reduces net interest cost to SOFR+2.45%. The filing is a financing transaction, not a special situation, as it involves ordinary debt refinancing and derivative hedging without change-of-control, activist, or strategic review elements.
